title.purpose: Compact document title in application chrome.

label.purpose: Short controls and document-view utility chrome.

shadows.name: document-edge
shadows.purpose: Separates a white legal page from the cream application surface.

motion.name: state-ease
motion.purpose: Fast button and border state feedback.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Effectively disables nonessential animation when reduced motion is requested.

components.name: Primary Step Button
components.description: The single decisive action for the current signing step.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #0D2B1D; color: #FFFFFF; font: 600 15px/1.2 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #081B12; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256346; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet secondary action that never competes with the signing step.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #C4BFB6; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #0D2B1D; font: 500 15px/1.2 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1), border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(37, 99, 70, 0.07); border-color: #256346; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256346; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Decline Button
components.description: A destructive action kept visually distinct from continuation.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 1px solid #991B1B; border-radius: 8px; background: transparent; color: #991B1B; font: 600 15px/1.2 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1); } .ds-btn-danger:hover { background: rgba(153, 27, 27, 0.07); } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #991B1B; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Signable Field
components.description: A legal-document field marker that reads as actionable, not erroneous.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: #1A1A1A; font: 600 13px/1.3 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #256346; border-radius: 6px; background: rgba(37, 99, 70, 0.10); color: #1A1A1A; font: 400 16px/1.4 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: #5A5A5C; opacity: 1; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256346; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Document Surface
components.description: The white legal page separated structurally from cream application chrome.
components.html:
Employment Agreement

Readable document content stays dominant.
components.css: .ds-document { max-width: 70ch; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid #C4BFB6; border-radius: 6px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #1A1A1A; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(13, 43, 29, 0.06); font: 400 16px/1.55 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-document h2 { margin: 0 0 12px; color: #0D2B1D; font-size: 18px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-document p { margin: 0; }

components.name: Recovery Link
components.description: A direct human recovery action available from terminal states.
components.css: .ds-recovery { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 4px; color: #256346; font: 600 14px/1.3 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-recovery:hover { color: #0D2B1D; } .ds-recovery:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #256346; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 4px; }

narrative.overview: Hamilton e-Sign should feel prepared for a worker opening important paperwork from WhatsApp, often outdoors or away from a desk. The visual system is calm and familiar so attention stays on reading, filling, and signing. Brand recognition comes from Hamilton green, the mark, and a consistent human voice rather than decorative UI. The component character is direct and reassuring.
keyCharacteristics: Phone-first document readability with a visible PDF escape hatch
Restrained Hamilton palette with semantic danger kept separate
Familiar controls sized for a thumb and explicit about consequences
One self-hosted sans family across chrome and document reflow
Structural borders and nearly flat elevation

rules.name: The Error Color Rule
rules.body: Danger red is forbidden for ordinary signable fields. Green identifies work to complete; red means an actual error or destructive action.

rules.name: The Document Contrast Rule
rules.body: The white legal page must remain visibly separate from the cream application surface through a line border, not a decorative shadow.

rules.name: The Chrome Is Not the Document Rule
rules.body: App titles stay compact and stable; legal-document hierarchy belongs inside the document surface.

rules.name: The Structural Flat Rule
rules.body: A border or tonal surface must explain depth before a shadow is introduced. Wide ambient shadows are prohibited.

dos: Do keep the document as the dominant surface and application chrome visually quiet.
Do use Hamilton Green for focus, links, and signable fields, and Danger only for decline or genuine errors.
Do preserve 44px touch targets, 2px focus outlines, readable placeholders, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do test every state at 390px, 768px crossings, desktop width, 200% text zoom, keyboard-only input, English, and Spanish.
Do keep a direct human recovery path on active, completed, declined, expired, archived, and awaiting pages.
donts: Don't add DocuSeal product marketing, white-label theater, or any page that promotes signing software during an employment task.
Don't present a dense scaled-down Letter PDF as the only mobile reading experience.
Don't style destructive decline controls like the primary continuation action.
Don't use red or pink ordinary field markers that look like validation errors.
Don't add decorative display typography, glass effects, gradients, oversized cards, or motion that distracts from reading and signing.
Don't strand a worker in a recovery state without a clear phone or WhatsApp path to a person.
Don't hide the PDF until every responsive field target is proven valid.
